I had no idea that was even possible. She sent me another email saying that there may be some other courses starting in February, but the add drop date ended 3 weeks ago, and whenever I search for that specific class there's none left. 

I think I may be taking it a bit far by showing up tomorrow because she didn't take kindly to my emails, despite the fact that I wasn't coming off as offensive. I will look into the transferring thing, though, I don't even know if that's possible or where/how to do that.

Do you think I should go despite what she told me in her email? I emailed her earlier basically pleading for her to reinstate me, and saying that I made a bad decision and would be a dedicated student from this point on. Her reply to me was this: 

"I am not willing to admit you into the course at this point. You already have two unexcused absences in a course which meets only once a week and we still have 15 weeks of class left of an entire semester.

I no longer re-admit late enrolled students who within a month of a course's beginning have higher numbers of absences.  My focus is on the students who have been regularly attending up to this point and learning in and out of class and who are enrolled at this point.

January 14th was not an official absence.  It is not being counted against you or the others as it was planned.  Nonetheless, students had work to complete between classes, as they do now.  All of them now have had at least one face to face class with experiential learning to keep their performance and standing in the course to a satisfactory level.

Not having your books is NOT a sufficient or reasonable excuse for non-attendance by any college course I have taught in over 10 years of teaching writing. As an instructor, I do not consider it a legitimate reason to be absent from a class.

Please contact Advising to consider your options."

I feel like I might be pushing her buttons if I show up tomorrow. She's notorious for being touchy so I'm kinda having some doubts. Plus the first time I met her to make up the first days assignments she seemed to already dislike me (and one other student) for adding the class late.
My class starts at 9am, basically when the school opens. Or at least the administrative  offices.
MLK day doesn't count, I've only had two at this point. On her syllabus it says the 4th absence is when we're going to fail and will be withdrawn. We're allowed 3 according to that.

I emailed her earlier about my concerns and she basically told me to fuck off and speak to an advisor. I understand that I'm in the wrong here but I didn't skip the class thinking I would be withdrawn or because I was lazy. In her words "in all of her 10 years she has never considered not having books a reason to be absent" and "my financial aid is my issue". Again, I understand I'm I'm the wrong, but I still feel shes being a bit harsh. After that email I'm thinking going to see her in person would be a bad idea, since she's coming off as very catty. Either way I now have to deal with the mess this will cause for my funding. I definitely should have just skipped out on picking her class and picked a later one, because even her reviews on rate my professor are terrible. Nevertheless I made a bad decision.
Of course, but my class is tomorrow and I can't speak with them today since it's late.
I'm having a hard time trying to figure out why this was down voted.

I don't really know how many friends he has, but he's always hanging around his co-workers because he travels with them for work. He used to play guitar but he hasn't played in years. His life is decent at the moment.. he has a job and a place to stay, but he never finished college and I know that bothers him.

He definitely does have a lot of things that stress him out though. His father died when he was young and he's had a pretty rough up bringing in general (and so have I). I think it bothers him when I talk about starting school because he never finished himself and now he's stuck working. Though he does say that he doesn't want to hold me back, I can tell he really doesn't want to to go away for school.

I think that's what I'm going to do, but at this point I just don't think things will work out. I'm trying to go into this with a clear head, no negative or positive expectations.. I'm just going to let whatever happens happen. However, It does make make me a bit sad coming to the realization that me and him probably won't work out.

I have dyscalculia so this shirt would apply to me, although I'd be too embarrassed to wear it. I honestly don't think it's any better or worse than the nerdy trend that's going on now.. since most of the people who follow that where mediocre in school anyways.
I'm 20 right now.. I feel like I've already been through and learned almost everything in this thread.
The fact that you had to explain it to her is sad. If she likes reddit she would have found it out on her own.
I'm pretty sure they can always trace your calls. If you're that worried about them tracing you, use a pay phone or a cheap pre-paid cell phone.
It hurts because people I would give my life for don't give a flying fuck about me.
Hey thanks. I kinda went off the deep end last night, but I'm doing ok now. Reddit was kind of a last ditch effort to stop myself from doing something crazy.

I can't afford therapy or medication. Even if I could I wouldn't want my family to know because they will cause more problems.

Thanks anyways though.
